topic: REST vs GraphQL: which API style fits your product
caption:
REST or GraphQL? Your API is how every screen of your app talks to the backend, so the style matters. 🔌

The founder's version:

✅ REST when your data is simple and predictable, with a few clients and clear resources
✅ GraphQL when many screens need different slices of connected data, across web and mobile
✅ Decide on how your apps will use the data, not on what's trending

Swipe for the details. →

slides.title: REST or GraphQL: which API does your app need?
slides.sub: It depends on how your screens use data. Swipe →

cols.name: REST
cols.text: One URL per resource: users, orders, payments. Simple, widely understood and easy to cache.

cols.name: GraphQL
cols.text: Each screen asks for exactly the fields it needs, in one request. More setup up front.

slides.title: Choose REST when…
slides.body: your data is simple and predictable: a few clients, clear resources, and screens that mostly show one thing at a time.

slides.title: Choose GraphQL when…
slides.body: many screens need different slices of connected data, often across a web app and a mobile app at once.

slides.title: Don't decide on hype.
slides.body: Both are proven. Decide on how your apps use the data and who will maintain the API later.
